notes: 2025 Form 1040 Social Security Benefits Worksheet (keep for your records), lines W1–W18. Component-level pins for lines 1z (bounded wages), 2b, 3b, 4b, 5b (absent), 7a, 8, 2a, and named Schedule 1 adjustments (all absent). Never reads line 9, AGI, taxable income, or a result containing line 6b. MFS living arrangement is required only for married filing separately and is never inferred from filing status. Half and 85% rates use bracket_fold over rate parameters; min uses choose. Rounding uses the project convention.
